bearerAuth.description: Deprecated GitHub bearer compatibility for local development and one-time native migration. It will be removed after supported native clients have upgraded.

browserSession.name: __Host-nox_session
browserSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly session created by GitHub OAuth for the first-party web application. Browser mutations also require X-CSRF-Token.

noxApiToken.description: Organization- and project-bound, service-scoped NoxConnect automation token. Store as a secret; the value is shown only once.

nativeSession.description: Short-lived first-party native application session. Refresh with a rotating nox_rt_ credential; provider credentials remain encrypted in NoxConnect.

ifMatch.name: If-Match
ifMatch.description: ETag returned by the latest service config GET

team.description: Slack only: team (workspace) ID like T08B8C3E91N that pins Slack's authorize page to one workspace. An empty string or null leaves the workspace choice to Slack's picker. Omitted pins the organization's currently connected workspace so reconnects can't hop.

channelId.description: Optional candidate channel; otherwise uses saved routing and fallback.

screenshot.description: Bounded PNG, JPEG, or WebP data URL

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for completed daily periods.

items.description: Exact HTTPS origin; localhost HTTP is allowed for development.

failureMessage.description: Default user-impact text shown with the actual bounded technical error.

enabled.description: Accept new events and include both derived outputs in reports.
Whether this repository-mirror row is explicitly enabled as a NoxConnect routing project

config.description: Shape depends on service. NoxSpot and NoxCue configuration is resource-scoped and linked from links.resources.

anyOf.description: NoxSpot and NoxCue have resource-scoped configuration; use links.resources.

projectScope.description: Null selects all projects; otherwise use the ID of an active project returned by GET /api/projects.

projectId.description: Project to own this workspace. Null is allowed only while it is the organization's sole workspace.

affectedUser.description: Opaque identifier; NoxCue stores only its SHA-256 hash.

userId.description: Stable app identifier; NoxCue stores only a source-scoped SHA-256 hash.

JsonValue.description: Legacy response whose stable typed schema has not yet been promoted into API v1.

projectId.description: One enabled NoxConnect project. The token cannot access resources assigned to another project.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid GitHub OAuth bearer token
